page_title: SEV 0-3 LEV | Sevilla v Levante 04/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' 0 - 3 Carlos Alvarez (Levante) gets on the end of a long pass that is slotted through the defence and easily sends the ball into the bottom left corner!

90+2' Mathew Ryan pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Isaac Romero (Sevilla) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the middle of the goal, but was stopped by the goalkeeper.
90+2' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) wastes a huge opportunity to score from the penalty spot. He attempts to slot low into the middle of the target, but Mathew Ryan pulls off a save.
90+2' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+2' Jeremy Toljan (Levante) has tested the patience of referee Iosu Galech and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+1' The Sevilla players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Sevilla! Let's see what he decides.

88' Unai Vencedor (Levante) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Iosu Galech with no other option than to blow for a foul.
87' Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Iosu Galech stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
85' Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) powers a header just wide of the right post following a cross into the middle of the box.
84' Iosu Galech shows a yellow card to Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) for his blatant foul.
80' Luis Castro has decided to make a change. Unai Vencedor (Levante) replaces Pablo Martinez Andres.
80' The substitution has been made. Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) has replaced Ivan Romero.
77' 0 - 2 Goal! Carlos Espi (Levante) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner.
75' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) commits a foul and Iosu Galech immediately signals a free kick.
75' That's a clear yellow card. Mathew Ryan (Levante) goes into the book.
71' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Levante comes to nothing.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jose Morales (Levante) comes onto the pitch for Iker Losada.
71' The attendance is 25303.
71' Luis Castro has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alan Matturro (Levante) replacing Diego Varela Pampin.
70' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
69' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Iosu Galech has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
67' The resulting set piece from Sevilla is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
67' Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
65' The corner is swung in but Sevilla can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
65' The substitution is prepared. Carlos Espi (Levante) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Kareem Tunde.
63' Diego Varela Pampin (Levante) is booked.
61' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
60' Sevilla have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
59' That will be all from Juanlu Sanchez who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Isaac Romero (Sevilla).
55' The ball is laid off to Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the right side of the goal and forces Mathew Ryan to make a decent save.
52' Sevilla take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

51' A neat pass is well received by Batista Mendy (Sevilla), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
46' Matias Almeyda makes a half-time substitution. Adnan Januzaj comes on in place of Peque (Sevilla).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Iosu Galech has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' 0 - 1 Iker Losada (Levante) latches on to a precise pass deep inside the box from Ivan Romero, and he beats the goalkeeper with a low accurate shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:1.
45+2' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
45+1' A pass travels right across the box to Djibril Sow (Sevilla) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper inside the left post, but Mathew Ryan denies him with a decent save.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Diego Varela Pampin (Levante) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Iosu Galech blows for a foul.
40' Iosu Galech blows his whistle as Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
40' Oso (Sevilla) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety.
38' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending the ball towards the bottom right corner only for Odysseas Vlachodimos to dive and make a save.
37' Batista Mendy (Sevilla) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Iosu Galech had an easy-decision to make.
35' Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
33' Oso (Sevilla) serves up a nice cross, but Mathew Ryan punches the ball away.
32' Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
31' The Sevilla players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Iosu Galech signals NO GOAL following the VAR review.
30' Sevilla score a goal, but the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.
30' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Oso (Sevilla) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
28' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Matias Moreno (Levante) was quite harsh and Iosu Galech didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
24' Neat passing move from Sevilla in order to create new attacking opportunities.
23' Ivan Romero (Levante) makes a strong challenge and Iosu Galech blows for a foul.
19' Close! Iker Losada (Levante) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
19' Iker Losada (Levante) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
17' Iker Losada (Levante) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
16' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
15' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
14' The game is interrupted. Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
13' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Carlos Alvarez (Levante), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
10' The foul by Kareem Tunde (Levante) was seen by Iosu Galech who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

8' Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Mathew Ryan, who pulls off a comfortable save!
6' A lofted cross from Kervin Arriaga (Levante) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
5' The free kick is delivered by Carlos Alvarez (Levante) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
5' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Iosu Galech saw the whole situation. A free kick has been awarded to Levante.
1' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Levante will have the kick-off.
Iosu Galech will referee today's match.
